title: Accessible festival evening: the correct 21:00 set with step-free travel
brief: Plan our three-person family visit to Pancho Libre's 21:00 set on July 31, 2027, in the Halifax test district, total at most 360 CAD. Ask me about access needs, travel and approval; confirm the current official show and step-free seating with the festival, watch for route changes, and reserve only the approved free access places. No purchases or payments.

pages.text: Free seated access places are reserved through the festival access desk (reserve_access): confirm the current official show through festival_search, agree the stage, step-free route, seats and budget with the family, then request the three places.
